item.title: TencentDB Agent Memory
item.description:
The Problem
AI agents waste time repeating work across sessions. Each new conversation restarts from zero—re-reading docs, re-discovering workflows, and re-explaining context. When multiple agents work on the same project, there is no shared memory layer, so knowledge silos form and teams lose institutional learning.

item.title: UpSnap
item.description:
The Problem
Managing Wake-on-LAN (WoL) for multiple machines typically requires either command-line tools, dedicated hardware, or manual ARP table lookups. Teams managing fleets of headless or remote servers need a centralized, web-accessible way to wake, ping, and optionally shut down machines without SSH access to each one.

item.title: cloudflare os
item.description:

Companies need a way to let employees build custom tools and automate workflows without creating security nightmares.

item.title: emexDE
item.description:

Xcode requires macOS, cloud-based solutions need connectivity, and on-device editors can't compile native binaries. This forces developers to carry laptops or delay work until they're at a desk.

item.title: shepherd
item.description:
The Problem
Agent runs are black boxes. When an agent writes files, calls APIs, or modifies state, there is no way to inspect, roll back, or replay that execution. Debugging requires re-running from scratch, and supervision requires trusting the agent's output without review. Docker containers are too slow for checkpointing, and Git snapshots capture only files, not execution state.
What This Does
Shepherd records agent execution as a reversible, Git-like trace. The core mechanism lives in co...

item.title: winboat
item.description:
The Problem

What This Does

item.title: wifui
item.description:

item.title: mixture of kittens
item.description:
The Problem
Standard Mixture-of-Experts training suffers from serialized compute and communication steps, frequent CPU-GPU synchronizations, and non-deterministic execution. These overheads compound on NVL72 systems where inter-GPU communication latency directly impacts training throughput. Existing solutions leave significant headroom on the table.
What This Does
Mixture-of-Kittens fuses all MoE computation and communication into a single CUDA megakernel (csrc/mok_megakernel.cuh). The kernel...

item.title: posta
item.description:
The Problem
Teams that rely on transactional or marketing email often need to use third-party services like SendGrid or Mailgun, which means sharing sensitive email infrastructure and delivery data with external providers. Self-hosting email delivery typically requires stitching together multiple tools—an MTA, a queue system, a template engine, analytics—and managing deliverability, bounce handling, and security yourself.
